name: knowledgec_query
description: Read knowledgeC.db, the application and device-state records macOS keeps for its own features (not an audit log): for each ZOBJECT row its stream, typed values (value_string, value_integer, value_double, value_type_code: the lock and backlight states are integers), raw and converted start, end and creation times (Apple epoch, 2001-01-01 UTC, to ISO 8601 UTC with the raw value kept), UUID, the other non-null ZOBJECT columns and, joined on the row's own foreign keys, every non-null column of its ZSTRUCTUREDMETADATA and ZSOURCE rows under their own names. The joins are made from the schema the file has; the answer says which tables joined, lists the tables and columns and carries a fingerprint of the three tables' columns. A stream's meaning, and whether it exists, depends on the build and the device: every stream in the file is inventoried (count, first and last start) whatever the filters, and none is assumed. since and until filter by start time (a record that began earlier and overlapped the window is not selected); a filter the database has no column for is listed in filters_unapplied and the answer is partial. A write-ahead log or hot journal beside the database holds committed rows the main file lacks: with one, the files are copied to a private directory, SQLite applies them there, the frames applied are counted and the copy is removed, so the evidence directory is never written to; without one the file is opened read-only and immutable. What it does not measure: Biome streams, other databases, whether a screen or focus state shows a person at the keyboard (it does not), or whether the stream was complete (retention varies). Every row carries its Z_PK and parser; rows are ordered by start then Z_PK; they are written to out_file as they are read (an existing file or link there is refused), or paged losslessly to a file the answer names.

db.description: A knowledgeC.db; any -wal, -shm or -journal beside it is used (in a private copy), so copy them out together

stream.description: A stream name or a LIKE pattern, e.g. '/app/inFocus' or '/app/%'

since.description: Only entries starting at or after this ISO 8601 UTC time (needs a ZSTARTDATE column; otherwise listed in filters_unapplied)

until.description: Only entries starting at or before this ISO 8601 UTC time (same)

limit.description: Entries shown inline (default 500). All are counted; the whole result is in out_file, or, when that is omitted, in a file under work/<your id>/tool-output/ (in a job, $OUT/tool-output/) that the answer names

out_file.description: JSONL path for every matching entry, written as each is read. The tool does not overwrite: an existing file or link at that name is refused

max_stage_bytes.description: The database and its sidecars are copied only up to this many bytes in all (default 2147483648); over it nothing is read and the answer says so
